title: ConformanceReportProduction
description: Production-grade conformance report. Records the outcome of running the BANZA conformance suite (levels L0–L4) and the financial invariants against a candidate operator implementation, with references to the evidence produced. A conformance report is a TECHNICAL result, NOT a certification and NOT a payment-service authorisation. The field 'ready_for_operator_external_review' means the report is ready to be submitted for the operator's own external review — it does NOT mean BANZA has certified, approved, or activated anything. BANZA does not process payments, settle value, or move funds; it is an open protocol.
_boundary: Production of the BANZA protocol, not financial production. BANZA is an open protocol; it does not process payments, settle value, or move funds. Licence/authorisation belongs to the operator, not to BANZA.

operator_id.description: Candidate operator under test (e.g. 'operator-a'). Never a commercial brand.

evidence_refs.description: References to evidence artifacts (logs, transcripts, digests) supporting the results.

ready_for_operator_external_review.description: True when the report is ready to be submitted for the operator's own external review. NOT a certification and NOT a BANZA approval.

_numeric_domain: Integers in a signed or digested BANZA artifact are bounded by the canonicalization in force (BCJ/1: |n| <= 2^53-1, spec/canonicalization.md P2). The bound is declared here so the schema and the canonicalization cannot disagree about what is representable.
